description: MAP-11: a provider id with reserved characters is percent-encoded when placed in the URL path

provenance.evidence: changes/2026-09-08-id-path-escaping.md (ratified 2026-09-08); docs/mapping-rules.md MAP-11. The id carries a space, '?', '#', '%' (and ':' on the resource-name dialect); the expected URL is quote(id, safe) applied by hand per MAP-11 rules 1-2 over the surface's pinned route (cases/<provider>/<surface>.json). No wire exchange: a provider has never returned such an id; the rule exists so that if one does, the request is loud, never misrouted.
